# volcano_import_sources (Data Source)

Projects available to import from a connected third-party platform (see volcano_user_import_connections).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_import_sources" "example" {
  import_provider = "other-platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `import_provider` (String) The import source provider, e.g. a hosting platform identifier.

### Read-Only

- `sources` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources))

<a id="nestedatt--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sources`

- `name` (String)
